user.title: Calorplan
user.description: The integration will be created. Then import your configuration with the calorplan.import_config service.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Calorplan only supports a single instance.

import_config.name: Import configuration
import_config.description: Replaces the whole plan with the one from a JSON file or an object.

path.name: Path
path.description: Path of an allowed JSON file (for example /config/calorplan.json).

run_slot.name: Run slot
run_slot.description: Runs the start of a slot right now.

force.name: Force
force.description: Ignores conditions, away mode and disabled slots.

set_away.name: Away mode
set_away.description: Turns away mode on or off (starts are skipped).

away.name: Away
away.description: True to turn away mode on.

test_notification.name: Test notification
test_notification.description: Sends a test notification to a channel.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reloads the integration and recreates its entities.

set_pause.name: Create or update pause
set_pause.description: Creates a pause (or updates the one with the same reason and scope): no starts are scheduled while it is active. Meant for automations; repeating the call does not duplicate pauses.

room_id.name: Room
room_id.description: Room identifier. If omitted, the pause applies to the whole house.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Reason for the pause (for example Vacation). It is the key to update or remove it.

from.name: From
from.description: First day, included. Defaults to today.

until.name: Until
until.description: Last day, included. If omitted, it has no end date until removed.

clear_pause.name: Remove pause
clear_pause.description: Removes the pauses with that reason (or identifier) from a room or the whole house. It does not fail if none exists.

room_id.name: Room
room_id.description: Room identifier. If omitted, whole-house pauses are used.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Reason of the pauses to remove.

pause_id.name: Identifier
pause_id.description: Identifier of the pause to remove.

set_room_enabled.name: Enable or disable room
set_room_enabled.description: Enables or disables all the slots of a room.
